decisions.reason: The table is one of the five points in reach and the gate to Room 8, the repellent and the whole far side of the aqueduct; six runs and no hand on it means the original's one-word hint (RUB) is not enough once the image itself is the thing players look at. Making the surface ask for a hand, letting push/press/put-hand-on count as a touch, and one hint-book line on the lair's dark keep the puzzle and its odds the original's.

Both vista runs lost the torch to the lake the move after picking it up. The warning belongs where the torch is new in hand: the torch's own description and the Western Shore's. The lake still fries it; nothing of the mechanic changes.

Four of six runs, three quitting on the ledge before the man spoke. The man's five-move clock is the original's and stays; what was missing was any sign that staying would be answered. Cues on arrival, on the failed climb and on the chest tried give that without moving him.

MAN-SEEN's loss of the man for leaving is faithful and stays; but the engine's 'You can't see any rope here' for a rope the player just watched go up is the world failing to speak. The ledge, the rope, a climb and a wait now say where it went and that he said he would be back.

A world bug: the sword's 'runes' noun tied with the carved wall in the one room where the wall's runes are the puzzle. 'Runes' is now the wall's word; the sword's are 'read sword' and 'read runes on sword'.

A world bug and a departure from SHADOW-ARRIVAL, which picks among the room's real exits. Fixed to draw only from each room's real ways out; the language cost (no drawn bound, no list indexing) is logged as friction 40.

The world side is accepted: 'throw lamp south' and its kin are now read whole and answered without the throw, so the direction is never dropped silently into a smash. The engine side, a reading that discards trailing words going ahead with a destructive act, is Sprout's and is logged as friction 37 for filing.

An engine bug the world cannot intercept: the split on and/then answers a clause it could not read with untrue world lines. Accepted as a friction entry (38) for filing with Sprout; no world change is possible or made.

Words the world's own prose offers should read. 'scramble down' and bare 'climb down' are a verb that takes the ledge's way down, and bare 'dig' works everywhere in Zork's voice, the quicksand digging back.

Accepted for the log (friction 39) against Sprout's addressee reading, as recommended. The second half is not expressible: no phrase can end in a slot that swallows free text, and the world already reads every near call the shore can name, so no world change is made.
Agreed and kept unchanged: the hood trap is legible and still a trap, which is what the brief's showcase asks of the duel.

Until Q4 arrives in round 7 the stairs should not read as a puzzle in that room. The refusal now says plainly that nothing left undone there is wanted, only what is still to be gathered elsewhere; the in-world line stays in-world.
A measurement gap already logged as friction 24; its status is updated with this round's evidence for the steward to file. No world change.

changes.what: The viewing table asks to be touched: examine, look in and search end with the surface leaning nearer; push/press on it transports as touch does; a `hand_on` intent reads 'put hand on the table' as a touch. The grue lair entered without a light says the dark is thicker than the usual kind and breathing.
The torch's description says it is a flame for dry land the lake puts out for good; the Western Shore's description says the water is the north shore's water and will open the hands as readily.

Ledge cues before the man appears: arriving reads that something not a tree moves at the brink and the rope twitches; the failed climb twitches and chuckles; the chest tried is found funny from above. The man's five-move clock is untouched.

While the man is away the ledge's description, `examine rope`, a climb at the missing rope and `wait` (a `:ledge_waiting` flag read by the `waited` passage) all say the rope went up with the chest and that he said he would be back.
'runes' and 'rune' removed from the sword's nouns so the carved wall owns the word; `read runes on [target]` and `read writing on [target]` added as phrases of `read`.

Each shadow room declares its real exits (`:nways`, `:w0`..`:w7`) and the figure's blocked direction is drawn only from them, with the draw's bound branched on the count since `random` takes a literal.

New verbs `throw_dir` (eight compass directions) and `throw_far` (up/down/across/away/over/far/ahead/overboard) read a thrown line whole and answer without the throw; `throw [target] across [aim]` added to `throw`, and a Lake aim is refused as too wide to throw across with the thing kept.

New no-role verb `scramble` ('scramble down', 'scramble', 'climb down', …) takes the ledge's way down, the rope at the cliff top, and asks for a direction elsewhere; new no-role verb `dig_here` (bare 'dig') answers by the ground: quicksand digs back, sand and shore are slow and tedious, rock is rock.
The secret door's north/down refusal reworded to say plainly that nothing left undone in that room is wanted, only what is still to be gathered in places not yet been.

Tests: ten existing tests re-goldened for the lines above (the blocked direction now a real exit, the ledge wait line, the Western Shore, the lair line, the table's pull, the door's refusal); `slain` repointed to walk into the figure's new blocked direction; three new tests `ledge_cues`, `throw_direction` and `dig_bare` pin the new behaviour. `npx sprout check` and `npx sprout test` pass (20 tests).

friction.md: entries 37 (a direction after a thrown thing dropped silently, the throw going ahead), 38 (compound lines answered falsely), 39 (a greeting followed by a sentence read as a greeting of the sentence), 40 (a draw's bound is a literal and a list cannot be drawn from), 41 (friction 22 again, for the ledge's wait), and a status note on 24 (reach misses the Prison Cell).

intent.md: a 'Round 5 (the revision after round 4)' section saying which quarters are built (Q1 and Q2, nothing widened) and what this playtest changed, including P11 kept as is and the logged-not-changed points; two new lines under secrets a player can find.
